brief:
Engineer Ahmad Muhammad Faisal Dib launched his game development career in Gaza with a borrowed laptop, initially relying on machines friends lent him to teach himself the field, Shehab Wire reported. He progressed from self-taught beginner to developing games for international platforms while working in virtual reality and simulation technologies.

Dib has since expanded his work to train children and students in digital design and virtual environments. He established a center dedicated to virtual reality and virtual environment applications, creating opportunities for others in Gaza to develop skills in these emerging technological fields.
